research_result.description: LinkedIn Ads (LinkedIn Marketing Developer Platform) provides RESTful APIs for managing advertising accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, ad creatives, reporting and analytics, lead sync, conversion tracking, and audience targeting.
research_result.credential_requirements: To access LinkedIn Ads APIs, developers must create an application in the LinkedIn Developer Portal, submit an application to access the Advertising API product, and obtain OAuth 2.0 access tokens (3-legged OAuth for member authorization) with required scopes such as r_ads, rw_ads, and r_ads_reporting.
research_result.main_blocker: Developer application approval and vetting by LinkedIn is required to access the Advertising API product.

evidence.claim: LinkedIn API uses OAuth 2.0 for member authorization and API authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The LinkedIn API uses OAuth 2.0 for member (user) authorization and API authentication.

evidence.claim: Access to LinkedIn Advertising API is gated behind an application process starting at Development tier and requiring review/approval for Standard tier.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: All applications start with Development tier. You must apply separately to upgrade to the Standard tier.

evidence.claim: LinkedIn Ads API provides REST endpoints for campaign management and advertising operations.
LinkedIn Advertising API provides comprehensive management capabilities across ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives, ad types, and analytics.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: These APIs provide all features available in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, including creation and management of ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives, ad types, and analytics.

evidence.claim: Community-developed MCP servers exist for the LinkedIn Marketing API.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the LinkedIn Marketing API.
